ValidationRule.description: Ticket Number can only be 1. Numeric Value. 2. 13 Digits. 3. Start with 189.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( NOT(ISNUMBER( Ticket_Number__c )), LEN( Ticket_Number__c ) != 13, LEFT( Ticket_Number__c , 3) != "189" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Ticket Number can only be 13 digits number and start with 189.
